cli_fix.difference: Only error exit handling in src/main.cpp changes; successful solver code unchanged. CPU campaign retains its frozen pre-fix binary; cross campaign uses validated binary.

halo_source.change: Post both receives and sends in the existing function, then wait for all before existing count checks and scatter; existing scratch retained.

interpretation: Strong scaling fixes total cells and steps. Weak scaling fixes per-rank cells and steps, not physical duration.
Primary metric is max_rank(driver-output); it includes setup, MPI calls and waiting.
PMPI durations include waiting; rank sums and per-stage maxima are not a disjoint wall-time partition.
Cross-host comparisons include differing VM configurations and do not isolate network bandwidth.
No timestamp alignment is performed between different hosts.
Warmups and profile runs are excluded from measured medians but all outputs are validated and retained.

paired-cpu.change: Post both receives and sends in the existing function, then wait for all before existing count checks and scatter; existing scratch retained.

paired-cross.change: Post both receives and sends in the existing function, then wait for all before existing count checks and scatter; existing scratch retained.

notes: Before is the integrated 814b8118 executable; concurrent changes only the MPI halo exchange region.
Primary medians exclude warmups and PMPI profiles. All saved outputs, including warmups, are compared bitwise.
Ratios below one favor the candidate; show all five paired ratios and unfiltered timing ranges.
CPU-local and two-host experiments are different placements; compare before/after only within each placement.
MPI posted calls and Waitall are recorded; no computation is overlapped with outstanding requests.
The existing send/receive scratch, tags, count validation, numerical kernels and MPI-OFF controls are preserved.

raw_data_policy: Raw HDF5, inputs and logs remain on servers in verified lossless archives; Git holds code, protocol, summaries and hashes.
